def max_elements(p):
    p_str = str(p)
    n = len(p_str)
    
    # If p is a single digit, it can only be formed from itself
    if n == 1:
        return 1
    
    # Check if p can be formed by concatenating two smaller numbers
    for i in range(1, n):
        left = int(p_str[:i])
        right = int(p_str[i:])
